source_tool: Closed-form expansion of Δf = (v_r/c) · f at IEEE-754 double precision; c = 299792458 m/s (CODATA 2018, SI exact).
notes: Phase 2 of the RF audit will regenerate these vectors from a textbook reference (Sklar §1.3.2 worked examples) plus an independent tool — current values are computed from the closed-form definition at full IEEE-754 precision.
Relativistic correction (Sklar §1.3.3) at LEO velocities ~7.5 km/s is O((v/c)²) ≈ 6×10⁻¹⁰ — well below the 1 µHz fixture tolerance, so the classical form is exact for the listed valid range.
